checks.lead: Grand Duke Vladimir Kirillovich of Russia (Russian: Владимир Кириллович Романов; 30 August [O.S. 17 August] 1917 – 21 April 1992) was a Russian aristocrat who was the Head of the Imperial Family of Russia, a position which he claimed from 1938 to his death in 1992.
